narrative.intro: Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies reported $2.1B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies received 1 award this period, with an average award size of $2.1B, and obligations are up 0.3% year over year. Historical obligations show FY21 at $1.7B, FY22 at $2B, FY23 at $1.8B, FY24 at $1.8B, FY25 at $2.1B, and FY26 at $2.1B. The numbers are contract obligations unless otherwise noted, and current-year totals are partial because they cover the fiscal year to date. This snapshot is focused on obligations and award counts, not on task-level descriptions, agencies, or expiring-contract details unless those items are listed separately.
